# @ndigo/telemetry-node

Node.js telemetry for Ndigo — NodeSDK configuration and Node platform instrumentations

Version-matched export index for the installed package. Read `README.md`
for usage; the workspace guide index ships with `@ndigo/cli` as
`assets/agent/docs-index.md`.

## Public exports

- `configureTelemetry` — Configures the global OpenTelemetry providers for one process.
- `resolveExporter` — Resolves a per-signal exporter spec. Pure — no providers are touched — so the shape table is unit-testable in one process. OTLP urls fail loud here (`new URL`)…
- `TelemetryConfig` *(type)* — Node telemetry configuration: the exporter chosen per signal (traces, metrics, logs), an optional sampler and instrumentation list, and the minimum severity ap…
- `SamplerSpec` *(type)* — Trace sampling configuration. Presets resolve to parent-based samplers so child spans inherit the root decision; a raw OTel `Sampler` passes through untouched.…
- `ExporterSpec` *(type)* — Per-signal exporter configuration, reaching parity with `@ndigo/telemetry-web`'s dev posture: - `undefined`/`'console'`/`{ console: true }` — console exporter…
- `ResolvedExporter` *(type)* — The resolved export choice for one signal.
- `AuthServerInstrumentation` — OpenTelemetry instrumentation for `AuthServerInstrumentation`.
- `BootInstrumentation` — OpenTelemetry instrumentation for `BootInstrumentation`.
- `ClusterInstrumentation` — OpenTelemetry instrumentation for `ClusterInstrumentation`.
- `DrizzleInstrumentation` — OpenTelemetry instrumentation for `DrizzleInstrumentation`.
- `HTTPServerInstrumentation` — Instrumentation for `HTTPServer.listen`/`close` and per-request handling.
- `RedisInstrumentation` — OpenTelemetry instrumentation for `RedisInstrumentation`.
- `HTTPResponseViewTargetInstrumentation` — Instrumentation for `HTTPResponseViewTarget.commit`.
- `ServerSentEventViewInstrumentation` — Instrumentation for `ServerSentEventView.renderTo` streaming.
- `WebSocketServerInstrumentation` — Instrumentation for NodeSocketSessionRegistry:
- `WebSocketServerInstrumentationOptions` *(type)* — Options for WebSocketServerInstrumentation.
- `ContextInstrumentation`
- `PrometheusMetricReader` — A pull metric reader for the Prometheus text exposition format.
- `SeverityFilterLogRecordProcessor` — A `LogRecordProcessor` that filters log records based on their severity number.
